original_inputs:
Draft an office network maintenance notice for all office employees. Its purpose is to explain the maintenance schedule and its possible impact.
Use a clear, calm, and direct tone. Format it with a short title, two body paragraphs, and three bullet points listing the actions employees need to take.

The IT team will perform office network maintenance from 10:00 p.m. on Saturday, September 21, until 2:00 a.m. the following day.
During maintenance, wired office networks, guest Wi-Fi, and internal printing services may experience intermittent interruptions.
The company VPN and cloud collaboration tools are expected to remain unaffected.
Employees should save their work before maintenance begins, avoid scheduling tasks that depend on the office network, and report any continuing issues to it-help@example.org after maintenance ends.
